fields.summary_ko.0: Nvidia Corp. (NVDA) achieved revenue of $215.9 billion (YoY +65.5%) and net income of $120.1 billion for fiscal year ended January 2026, delivering a net profit margin of 55.6%, while maintaining very strong financial health with a debt ratio of 0.1x.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix recorded revenue of $72.6 billion (YoY +46.8%) and net income of $32.1 billion for fiscal year ended December 2025, achieving a 44.2% net profit margin and benefiting from strengthened AI memory chip demand.
